lens_findings_considered.finding: developLive's source-scope mode is the Git tracked-file census (not HX); however a separate live-composition.ts root wires discoverTaskScope (HX) with fail-closed coverage, so 'Mechanical's current mode is git-census' holds for developLive, not for every rig entrypoint.

lens_findings_considered.finding: SKILL.md, 03-implementation-and-qa.md and 04-agent-handoff.md restate 01's observations without new citations; all five files landed in one commit (7c80c34) by one author, so a proposition appearing in three program files has one origin and its warrant is whatever 01's code citation establishes at the pin.

Re-located at the MW pin: hx-scope.ts default native query returns revision:null, scopeKind:'filesystem' (33) and completeness requires scopeKind==='task' with revision===request.baseRevision (45); unchanged since baseline.

The token 'git-census' names a PROPOSED profile in Pi 02 (and the MW program README) and appears in no MechanicalWorkflows .ts file at the pin; the existing behaviour is developLive's tracked-file census (evidence kind 'tracked-file-census', docs/14 line 10), so 'explicitly selectable git-census profile' (C0320) is the program's own vocabulary read back as an observation.

NARROWS on 'explicitly selectable profile': the Git tracked-file census journey is real and labeled honestly in comments and evidence ids, but 'git-census' is not a shipped selectable identifier at the pin - LiveDevelopmentResult hardcodes discovery:'git-tracked-files' and the only selectable axis is contextMode 'plain'|'rf'; the profile names git-census/native-task-scope exist only as the program's proposals.
